boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented University of Delaware rituals, recurring events and campus customs that connect Blue Hens across the academic year.

cards.title: Join the candlelit Blue Hen welcome
cards.subtitle: Central Green • UD Welcome Days
cards.notes: Wear blue and gold, gather on Central Green and take in the formal welcome from UD leadership at this fall-semester candlelight ceremony.
cards.short_summary: A candlelit opening to the Blue Hen community.
cards.evidence_claim: UD describes Twilight Ceremony as a beloved candlelight ceremony on The Green that officially welcomes students with UD leadership.
cards.source_title: Blue Hen Traditions | University of Delaware
cards.access_notes: Scheduled as part of UD Welcome Days; consult the current Welcome Days program for attendance details.

cards.title: Browse the semester’s organization tables
cards.subtitle: UD campus • fall and spring
cards.notes: Walk the fair with time to ask questions, collect details and identify groups to revisit; UD lists more than 400 clubs and activities.
cards.short_summary: UD’s recurring introduction to campus organizations.
cards.evidence_claim: UD identifies the Involvement Fair as a fall-and-spring opportunity to explore more than 400 clubs, organizations and activities.
cards.source_title: Blue Hen Traditions | University of Delaware
cards.access_notes: Held each fall and spring; confirm the current location and schedule through Student Life.

cards.title: Learn the game-day repertoire
cards.subtitle: Delaware Stadium • UD Welcome Days
cards.notes: Attend the Welcome Days pep rally and tailgate to learn the fight song, alma mater and game-day customs alongside campus spirit groups.
cards.short_summary: A Welcome Days primer on Blue Hen game traditions.
cards.evidence_claim: UD says Gameday 101 brings incoming students together to learn the fight song, alma mater and other game-day traditions.
cards.source_title: UD Welcome Days | University of Delaware
cards.access_notes: A Welcome Days program; current dates and participation information are posted by Orientation & Transition Programs.

cards.title: Wear blue and gold on Friday
cards.subtitle: Campuswide • #BlueHenFridays
cards.notes: Build a simple Friday routine around blue-and-gold clothing, then use the campus hashtag if you want to share your school-spirit photo.
cards.evidence_claim: UD invites students to show Blue Hen pride by wearing blue and gold every Friday and using #BlueHenFridays.
cards.source_title: Blue Hen Traditions | University of Delaware
cards.access_notes: Campuswide practice; no registration is indicated on the University traditions page.

cards.title: Follow the fall Homecoming buildup
cards.subtitle: Newark campus • fall semester
cards.notes: Check the current Homecoming calendar for student events and the game-week buildup, then choose an activity that fits your schedule.
cards.short_summary: A fall gathering point for students, alumni, families and friends.
cards.evidence_claim: UD states that students, alumni, families and friends celebrate Homecoming each fall through festivities leading to the game.
cards.source_title: Blue Hen Traditions | University of Delaware
cards.access_notes: Events vary by year; use UD’s current Homecoming listing for individual event requirements.

cards.title: Lean into Geek Week
cards.subtitle: UD campus • recurring program week
cards.notes: Look for the current Geek Week schedule and pick a tournament, speaker, arcade activity or other program that matches your interests.
cards.short_summary: A newer UD tradition celebrating students’ “inner geek.”
cards.evidence_claim: UD calls Geek Week a recent campus tradition featuring activities such as game tournaments, guest speakers and on-campus arcades.
cards.source_title: Blue Hen Traditions | University of Delaware
cards.access_notes: Programming changes by year; consult the event details linked from Student Life.

cards.title: Watch the Greek Week competitions
cards.subtitle: UD campus • spring semester
cards.notes: Follow the spring schedule for Greek Games, Airband and related philanthropy-focused competitions, and attend only events open to you.
cards.short_summary: A spring competition week tied to fraternity and sorority philanthropy.
cards.evidence_claim: UD describes Greek Week as a spring week of events and competitions among fraternities and sororities supporting philanthropic efforts.
cards.source_title: Blue Hen Traditions | University of Delaware
cards.access_notes: Participation and attendance vary by program; consult the current fraternity and sorority-life schedule.

cards.title: Mark the last Friday of classes
cards.subtitle: UD campus • end of spring semester
cards.notes: Check the Senior Week calendar, then join the last-Friday-of-classes program for lawn games, inflatables and scheduled entertainment if available.
cards.evidence_claim: UD describes Senior Fling as a long-standing event on the last Friday of classes and says all UD students are welcome.
cards.source_title: Blue Hen Traditions | University of Delaware
cards.access_notes: Occurs during Senior Week; UD says all students are welcome. Check the current program for location and timing.

cards.title: See the five-kiss legend
cards.subtitle: Adjacent to Memorial Hall • The Green
cards.notes: Visit the triple brick arches and treat the marriage promise as campus lore: UD’s archivist says the story is apocryphal, not proven history.
cards.short_summary: A romantic campus legend with a clearly disputed origin.
cards.evidence_claim: UD documents the tradition that five kisses beneath the arches promise marriage, while its archivist says there is no proof and calls it apocryphal.
cards.source_title: The Messenger: UD’s Lore and Legends | UDaily
cards.access_notes: Outdoor landmark adjacent to Memorial Hall; respect others’ boundaries and the historic setting.

cards.title: Try the Morris Library good-luck rub
cards.subtitle: Hugh M. Morris Library entrance
cards.notes: Find the Hugh M. Morris bust at the library entrance and give its polished nose a respectful rub before an exam—then head inside to study.
cards.short_summary: A library-doorstep superstition for exam-season luck.
cards.evidence_claim: UD identifies rubbing the Hugh Morris bust’s nose for a good grade as a campus legend and notes the nose shows countless student touches.
cards.source_title: The Messenger: UD’s Lore and Legends | UDaily
cards.access_notes: At the entrance to Morris Library; do not climb on or damage the bust.
